exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "It would be good if / should / I hope".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
～たらいい
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ～たらいい matches "It would be good if / should / I hope".
